charts.title: The contract — results out (left) and verification out (right), across models and engines
charts.caption: The simulation-core contract, demonstrated. One interface — simulate(model, request) — takes a model (an SBML file, the same model with a cross-engine check, a different engine, or a registered composite) and returns results (left) plus a structured verification (right): ran, finite, physical admissibility per observable, and optional cross-engine agreement. 4/4 runs verified; the two exact-SBML engines (Tellurium, COPASI) agree to ~1e-4. Every run carries its own evidence.
